en: A multi-view vintage postcard titled in red "Gruss aus Kronstadt." It shows four photographs of Brașov/Kronstadt: the town hall with a clocktower and a busy market scene (captioned "Rathaus"), the main marketplace ("Marktplatz"), a building labeled "Villa Kertsch," and a panoramic view of a hill labeled "Schlossberg." Publisher credit along the left reads "Wilh. Hiemesch, Buchhandlung, Kronstadt." The front is filled with a handwritten German message dated from Bistritz. The reverse is a Hungarian 'Levelező-Lap' with a green Magyar Kir. Posta stamp and postmarks, addressed to Hermannstadt (Nagyszeben).
